name: Evolving unison pad with filter swell and fifth layer
goal: From a Vital-style workflow: shape a pad with immediate amp and slow filter-open envelope, unison with spread, slow LFO→cutoff, layer a fifth (and optional higher) osc through the same filter with unison, compress, large reverb, optional chorus; keep peaks controlled.

source.title: Sound Design with VITAL - Wide BASS - Evolving PAD - Lead PLUCK

prerequisites: Subtractive/WT synth with unison, dual env, filter, compressor, reverb, chorus

inputs.name: interval_layer
inputs.description: Harmonic interval in semitones for second osc (classic +7 fifth)

constraints: Ground every step in the source YouTube-provided captions; do not invent UI or settings.
Original synthesis only — map brand UI (Serum/Vital/Pigments/Phase Plant/etc.) to portable osc/filter/FX roles for a browser or generic hybrid synth; never rip presets, wavetables, or samples.
Prefer transferable signal-flow and motion relationships over vendor-specific preset names.
This skill uses only the pad portion of the source video (not the bass/pluck recipes).

steps.action: Init tonal osc (saw/rich wave). Amp can be quicker; env2 slow attack → filter cutoff with low resonance so tone arrives then opens.
Add unison with noticeable stereo spread; optional slow LFO→cutoff for ongoing motion.
Second osc pitched a fifth (+7) into the same filter with similar/less unison so it coheres as a chordal pad; optional third higher voice with LFO→level for late shimmer.
Multiband or glue compression to control peaks and bring highs; large size/decay reverb with rising mix; optional chorus for extra spread; watch distortion from overload.

verification: Fifth layer present through shared filter
